text:
eva: Heads-up — kicking off RotorWing-7B runtime bring-up. Goal: quick compatibility + regressions smoke (RoPE behavior, KV cache stability, q4/q8 quant tests). Putting intake here.

sahil: what's the training RoPE/freq_base and pos-encoding details?

ina: model card says rotary with freq_base=10000, but preproc uses 4096 downscale hack. saw divergence in long-context LM eval at ~1200 tokens on q4.

thomas: that smells like rotary freq mismatch or incorrect RoPE exponent scaling in our kernel. can we repro with a deterministic prompt?

eva: yes — repro prompt attached below. first smoke should be: 1) run 2 warmup inferences, 2) one long generation (2k tokens), 3) compare token-level logprobs vs reference. keep full kv traces.

julie: assigning tasks: @sahil -> quant profile sweep (q4_0, q4_1, q8_0); @ina -> kv-eviction + long-context smoke; @thomas -> rotary kernel sanity and PR if mismatch.

ina: quick commands I used locally:
```
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/generate \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rotorwing-7b","prompt":"<long_init>","max_tokens":2000}'
```

ina: excerpt from failed run (q4_0) — look at sudden prob drop around token 1187:
```
[2026-03-12T14:12:03Z] step=1185 token=... logp=-1.2
[2026-03-12T14:12:04Z] step=1186 token=... logp=-1.1
[2026-03-12T14:12:05Z] step=1187 token=... logp=-6.9  <-- big drop
[2026-03-12T14:12:06Z] step=1188 token=... logp=-7.0
```

thomas: that drop pattern is consistent with kv-mismatch or cache eviction feeding zeros. Nina, can you dump the KV checksum before/after eviction? add `--kv-checksum` flag to runtime.

deploy-bot: quick-smoke (rotorwing-7b, q4_0) completed on staging: 3/10 samples showed context drift > 6 tokens; avg latency 98ms/token; full logs at https://ci/internal/rotorwing/smoke/194567.

sahil: initial quant notes: q4_0 gives smaller size but more instability on this arch. q8_0 is larger but stable. plan: run approx 200 eval prompts from our long-context benchmark and compute KL/JS vs fp16 baseline.

julie: prioritization: P0 = reproducible drift in hosted runtime (customer-facing); P1 = quant quality gap vs baseline; P2 = perf tuning. If P0 repro, we block rollout.

eva: proposed checklist for this thread (short):
- [ ] reproduce with single deterministic prompt on local runtime
- [ ] capture kv checksums and compare steps pre/post drop
- [ ] run RoPE kernel parity test vs reference (numpy impl)
- [ ] quant sweep: q4_0, q4_1, q8_0 on eval set (200 prompts)
- [ ] compare token-level logprobs and perplexities to fp16 baseline
- [ ] if mismatch -> create minimal failing unit test for runtime repo
- [ ] coordinate canary on Dedicated once passing

ina: I'll start KV checksum instrumented runs and upload traces to the shared S3 bucket s3://redwood-test/rotorwing/traces/194567.

thomas: I'll add small unit that loads weights with current RoPE scaling and compares per-head rotary matrices to numpy baseline. will ping when PR up.

sahil: starting quant sweep now. will report JS divergence numbers in thread.

eva: thanks. please paste quick findings here (one-liners). we want to decide rollout gating tomorrow afternoon. :eyes:

julie: noted — planning to keep Hosted off for RotorWing until P0 resolved. will update runway docs and blocklist. :lock:

sahil: quick 1-liner update: q8_0 matches fp16 KL < 0.02, q4_0 KL ~ 0.18 on long-context set.

nina: KV checksum diff: pre-drop 0x7a3f1c, post-drop 0x000000 (indicative of zeroed cache). attaching trace id: trace-194567-1.

thomas: yep that's a zeroing bug — looks like an ASAN-protected path in kv_eviction when sequence length > kv_bucket_size. working on fix.

eva: perfect. leave any small scripts/config snips here for handoff. we'll reconvene once thomas has a patch and sahil finishes sweep. :thumbsup:
